description: Casa Azúcar is a quiet jungle oasis tucked on a residential side street in the heart of Puntas, Rincón. Enjoy the saltwater pool, backyard BBQ, upper-terrace sunsets, and a relaxed, private setting. This spacious 3BR/2.5BA home offers stunning ocean views and FULLY OFF GRID reliability with solar power, backup water, and satellite internet. The house runs entirely on solar with a back-up generator.The spaceThis spacious 3BR/2.5BA home is perfect for families or groups of friends. The entry opens into a large sitting and dining area that flows into a fully equipped kitchen, plus a half bath and secondary lounge space. Upstairs are three AC-cooled bedrooms: a primary with a king bed, en suite bath, and private terrace; a queen bedroom; and a third room with a twin bed and small sofa. A second full bath and stackable washer/dryer are in the hallway. Light, airy, and comfortable with plenty of room for both privacy and shared time together.Guest accessThe guests have access to the entire property. There is a driveway that leads down from the main house that is another residential property. That property is not part of this rentalOther things to noteCasa Azucar is a Solar Powered, Sustainable, Eco-Green 100% Off-Grid Home.This eco-friendly home operates entirely on solar power and is designed to minimize its environmental impact while maximizing comfort. Features include energy-efficient appliances, a high-efficiency washer and dryer, energy-saving air conditioning units, ceiling fans throughout the home, and LED lighting.Guests are encouraged to use the outdoor laundry line, allowing clothes to dry quickly and naturally in the Caribbean sun. The home also includes a Berkey water filtration system, low-flow water fixtures to conserve water, and a backup water cistern with rainwater collection to ensure a reliable water supply year-round.The Salt-Water pool has a low-flow efficient water pump that runs day & night. PLEASE BE AWARE THAT RUNNING YOUR A?C UNITS THROUGHOUT THE DAY AND NIGHT MIGHT CAUSE A LOSS OF POWER. We strongly suggest that you turn off the AC units when not in the room or when you go put for the day.

description: Enjoy a stylish home with modern luxury inspiration & premier views of the Caribbean Sea. Our homes feature two master suites with Yorkshire Manor Premium Comfort Beds, Living Room Designer Everleigh Place Topaz Gel Foam Sleeper Sofa, two full baths equipped with warm & relaxing dual rainfall custom performance shower heads and tub, two balconies with fantastic views of the ocean & Rincon sunsets plus a spectacular entry view of Desecheo island.The spaceAt Rincon Ocean Luxe, we pride ourselves on offering exceptional 5 star experiences. Enjoy a stylish home with modern luxury inspiration & premier views of the Caribbean Sea. Our homes feature two master suites with Yorkshire Manor Premium Comfort Beds, Living Room Designer Everleigh Place Topaz Gel Foam Sleeper Sofa, two full baths equipped with warm & relaxing dual rainfall custom performance shower heads and tub, two balconies with fantastic views of the ocean & Rincon sunsets plus a spectacular entry view of Desecheo island. Every room is equipped with state of the art technology: Samsung Smart 65 inch wide screen Cinematic TV media entertainment centers in each bedroom (85 inch in the living room) all with app streaming capabilities, cable TV + Hi-Speed WIFI; Smart Kitchen (Dual Door Fridge, Range, Food Waste Disposer & Dishwasher) & Laundry (Front Load Washer & Dryer) appliances.Our Kitchens are well stocked with Fine Silver & Dinnerware, Glassware, Cocktail-ware (Wine, Champagne, Margarita, Martini, Moscow Mule & Shot); Healthy Ceramic Cookware Pots; Ninja Air Fryer & Indoor Grill; Baking Sheets, Roasting Pans, Stuffed Belgian Waffle Maker; Hot Sandwich Presser; Ninja Pro Blender for Smoothies, Frozen Drinks & Nutrient Extractions; Electric Kettle with Tea Infuser; Revolution digital touchscreen multi-bread toaster.Enjoy a morning fresh premium Puertorican coffee in our Breville professional touchscreen Barista Coffee Expresso machine with bean grinder.Stay on top of your business in our custom home office workspace with dual HDMI widescreen LED monitors, USB keyboard & mouse and wireless printer.Or Just relax in our resort style pool & outdoor living spaces; Have fun with our Kayaks, Paddle board, life vests, snorkeling gear, inflatable Flamingo & Unicorn floats, beach toys, exercise gear, reading literature, volleyballs, footballs, basketballs, soccer balls, pickleball paddle set, board games; plus lots of extras like baby play pen (for our little guests), hammock, beach umbrellas, towels, blankets, chairs, lounge chairs, cargo carts & coolers.Skip the hassle with our Express Self-Check in/out process & Smart Lock Systems.Our luxury properties are ideal for up to 6 people, include a dedicated hot water system and are protected by an emergency backup system including industrial power generator and water cistern to protect your stay against those occasional and unforeseen service interruptions in Puerto Rico. title: Enticing Poolside Beachfront Escape for 4
description: Take a break and unwind at this peaceful oasis in beautiful Córcega Beach, Rincón. This ground-level, poolside beachfront apartment is perfect for up to 4 guests, just steps from the pool and beach access. Enjoy easy outdoor living, a calm tropical feel, magical west coast sunsets, and a convenient location close to downtown Rincón, restaurants, shops, beaches, and local favorites. A wonderful place to relax, recharge, and enjoy the island lifestyle.The spaceThis is a cozy garden-level studio designed for a relaxed beach stay in Rincón. The space has an open, comfortable layout with a main sleeping area, living and dining space, kitchen, bathroom, and private patio.Bedding setup:1 king bed in the main sleeping area\1 daybed with a pull-out trundle, which includes two twin mattressesThe studio comfortably sleeps up to 4 guests. Linens, pillows, and blankets are provided.The space is simple, comfortable, and convenient for couples, solo travelers, or small families who want to stay close to Corcega Beach, the pool, and the beautiful west-facing sunsets Rincón is known for. The patio is a nice spot to relax after the beach, enjoy the tropical breeze, or unwind at the end of the day.Guest accessGuests have access to the entire studio, including the bedroom area, bathroom, living and dining space, kitchenette, and private patio.Guests may also enjoy the shared condo amenities, including the pool area, common walkways, and the nearby beach access gate. The beach is just a few feet away from the studio, making it easy to enjoy Corcega Beach and the beautiful Rincón sunsets.Parking for one car only is available on the property, and detailed arrival, parking, and access instructions will be shared through Airbnb before check-in.Other things to noteThis is a cozy garden studio in a residential beachfront condo community. Please keep in mind that this is not a hotel, so starter supplies are provided, but refills are not included during the stay.Only the registered guests included in the reservation are allowed on the property. No parties, events, loud music, smoking, or visiting animals are allowed. These rules are very important because this is a peaceful residential community with neighbors and HOA rules.Please keep doors and windows closed when using the AC so the system can cool properly. Puerto Rico can also experience occasional power, water, or internet interruptions outside of the host’s control, although they are usually temporary.The pool and common areas are shared with the condo community. Please enjoy them respectfully and follow any posted building or pool rules.Access instructions and codes are shared only through Airbnb for security, verification, and reservation protection.

title: Beachfront Villa Sol in Rincon. Perfect location
description: Enjoy beach views in the heart of Rincón, Puerto Rico. Prime location with island charm and unforgettable sunsets. Walk to restaurants, swimming, snorkeling, and world-class surf spots from this home in the gated Puerto Bahía community. Villa Sol is perfect for relaxing or remote work with fast 500 Mbps WiFi. Tres Palmas Marine Reserve begins just 300 feet from Marina Beach. Maria’s and Domes are 1.5 miles away. Markets and dining are 2 minutes away, and BQN Airport is just 30 minutes away.The spaceHomey, yet open home in one of Rincón's most desirable neighborhoods. Villa Sol is a a two-minute walk from the closest swimming beach, with other beaches within walking distance. With secure parking, a fully equipped home, back up power, and proximity to all the highlights of PR's west side, it has everything for guests to comfortably live an island-beach life, short or longer term.Guest accessThe entire home + the community pool.Other things to noteSolar energyThe solar system is meant to power the entire home. To help it run most efficiently and keep you comfortable, please observe the following: - Keep bedroom doors closed while ACS are running- Turn off all lights when leaving the home- On very cloudy days, monitor use of ACs and fans - In the event of several consecutive, cloudy days or a full power outage, the more mindful we are of electrical use, the better the battery back up power will be for use. - Please do not touch or manipulate any of the solar equipment.

It is a private single family home,so the grounds are share with no one.This Spanish style home can comfortably accommodate 6-9 guests. Take a dip in the large recreational swimming pool, barbecue in our new outdoor pool side kitchen/gazebo, catch the sunset on the roof deck, or take a short walk to Corcega (Rincon's swimming beach) less than 200 yards away. The Sand Castle Villa is conveniently located near all; supermarkets, banks, restaurants, liquor store, pharmacy, video store, surfing beaches and nightlife. Also available nearby is a running track, gym, horseback riding, bike & surf board rentals, jet ski & banana boat rides, scuba diving, snorkeling, and charter boats for fishing. title: La Pina Suite | Steps from the beach
description: Recently refreshed from top to bottom. The La Piña Suite is a private boutique retreat steps from one of Rincon’s secluded hidden beaches. This newly remodeled 2-bedroom suite features a king bed, queen bed, full kitchen, ocean-view coffee terrace, romantic outdoor soaking tub, private rainfall shower, and indoor two-person rainfall shower. Guests enjoy rooftop sunset fire pits, pool, BBQ area, Wi-Fi, AC, smart TVs, plus complimentary beach chairs, cooler, and umbrella for relaxing beach days.The spaceTucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchen with a gas-burning stove/oven with flat top griddle, microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the foot wash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting into the pool. All kitchens have cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
